long_review.hot_take: OANDA is the original no-minimum-deposit US forex broker — operating since 1996, predating most of its competitors by a decade. The $0 minimum and per-unit position sizing (no lot requirement) make it the most flexible entry point for US traders. But in 2026, the absence of raw ECN pricing means active traders pay more per trade than they would at FOREX.com RAW. OANDA trades on heritage and flexibility rather than cost leadership.

sections.heading: Is OANDA Worth Your Money in 2026?
sections.body:
Formerly Admiral Markets, rebranded as OANDA in 2021, this Estonian-headquartered broker has been operating since 2001 — making it one of the oldest retail forex brokers still active. Regulated by CySEC, FCA, ASIC, EFSA, and CIMA, the compliance footprint spans five jurisdictions. The Zero account offers raw spreads from 0.0 pips with a commission starting from $6 per lot round-turn — competitive with Tickmill and cheaper than Pepperstone.

The platform offering is strong: MT4, MT5, and a proprietary MetaTrader Supreme Edition plugin that adds features MetaQuotes never built — mini terminal, sentiment indicators, tick charts, and a correlation matrix. For MT4/MT5 power users, this plugin alone justifies consideration. Over 8,000 instruments including real stock investing through the Invest.MT5 account type puts OANDA in rare territory — a broker that serves both CFD traders and actual equity investors.

OANDA suits the trader who wants MT4/MT5 with enhanced tools, competitive raw pricing, and the option to invest in real stocks alongside CFD trading. If you need cTrader or TradingView, look elsewhere.

sections.heading: Is OANDA Regulated? — Licence Check 2026
sections.body:
Yes — across five jurisdictions. Admiral Markets Cyprus Ltd holds CySEC licence 201/13. Admiral Markets UK Ltd is FCA authorised (595450). Admiral Markets Pty Ltd is ASIC regulated (410681). Admiral Markets AS is licensed by EFSA Estonia. And OANDA SC Ltd operates under CIMA (Cayman Islands) for international clients.

Fund segregation applies across all entities. FSCS covers UK clients up to GBP 85,000. ICF covers EU clients up to EUR 20,000. No compensation scheme under CIMA. OANDA does not appear on any active warning list. NAFT last reviewed OANDA regulation in May 2026.

sections.heading: OANDA Spreads, Fees and Accounts — What Do You Actually Pay in 2026?
sections.body:
OANDA offers five account types. The Trade.MT5 account has spreads from 0.5 pips with zero commission — approximately $5-8 per lot all-in. The Zero.MT5 account offers 0.0 pips raw with commission from $6 round-turn — directly competitive with Tickmill and cheaper than Pepperstone. The Invest.MT5 account allows real stock and ETF investing with ownership — not CFDs.

No inactivity fee for the first 24 months — after which a $10/month fee applies. Overnight swaps are standard. No deposit or withdrawal fees on most methods. The MetaTrader Supreme Edition plugin is free for all live account holders.

sections.heading: OANDA Final Verdict — Is It Worth It in 2026?
sections.body:
NAFT scores OANDA 7.4 out of 10. Five regulatory licences, Zero account at $6 RT matching the cheapest ECN pricing, real stock investing via Invest.MT5, and the MetaTrader Supreme Edition plugin make this a genuinely differentiated offering. The $25 minimum deposit is among the lowest in the regulated space.

Weaknesses: no cTrader, no TradingView, and the inactivity fee after 24 months. These matter less for active traders but limit appeal for platform-diverse traders.

NAFT recommends OANDA for MT4/MT5 loyalists who want enhanced tools, low-cost ECN trading, and the option to invest in real equities — all under one roof.
